protocol.order: Original CASES first-appearance mission order; ascending K; rep1 sweep,sipp then rep2 sipp,sweep, one ABBA quadruple per mission/K

construction.jitter_domain: full native construction then original exact inclusive regional crop
construction.initial_fire: original metadata max-remaining enclosure with explicit full-T for unknown initial age

protocol.source_preflight: Read-only full file SHA256, original1024 header and first32 prefix SHA256, embedded clock/CRS/policy binding, canonical raw fields, first-hour support, original metadata settings, exact existing window/affine/masks. Refuse mismatch; never coerce.
protocol.witness: Reload and reauthenticate original first-K/raw arrays and request after each returned typed contact route; use independent raw-data geometry checker, save separately from planner claim.
protocol.reporting: Unknown endpoints: all K/method/rep records, search_startedFalse, solver_metricsnull and planner_wall_snull. No admission-only times in paired solver costs. Distinct solver counters; unresolved timeouts/exhaustion visible; no global original-domain no-route/optimum, thermal, risk, Wilson or physical claim.
protocol.fragmentation: T>H means at most one safe full-traversal departure interval under this prefix/tail law; report actual counters without presumed monotonic fragmentation/speedup.
